name: SH3 and PX domains 2A

function.text: SH3PXD2A encodes SH3 and PX domain-containing protein 2A. Annotated molecular activities include superoxide-generating NADPH oxidase activator activity and phosphatidylinositol binding. It participates in osteoclast fusion and superoxide anion generation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
